parsed.rationale: I don't think this is an acute STEMI: the tracing shows sinus rhythm at about 70-75 bpm with a normal PR interval and narrow QRS, and V2-V5 show only slight upsloping J-point elevation with upright T waves that fit normal or early repolarization rather than ischemic ST elevation, with no reciprocal ST depression, no pathological Q waves, and no ST elevation in two contiguous leads that meets STEMI criteria (limb leads I, III and aVL are noisy).
